title: Engine-rolled death saves and recharge rolls with a recorded DM override
description:
Implements the user decision on eshyra-o9bd.19.5.14 (2026-11-07). record_death_save and restore_usage (recharge mode) today accept a caller-supplied natural die result that is only range-checked; the auditor model is the only guard. ADR 0020 section 3 makes random-number generation a deterministic responsibility.

DECISION: the engine rolls by default; the DM may still supply its own result, following the start_effect item-duration precedent (packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolStartEffect.ts: omit duration = engine rolls the printed dice; a supplied value requires durationOverride { basis: "dm-adjudicated" | "house-rule", reason, ruleId? }, ruleId must name an active house-rule campaign rule, and the override is recorded as unbound). The engine roll must honor modifiers that only the DM knows about.

SCOPE
1. record_death_save: roll becomes optional. Omitted: the engine rolls the d20 from ctx.rng (seeded, exactly as resolve_check does), honoring new optional advantage/disadvantage (reuse ADVANTAGE_SCHEMA/DISADVANTAGE_SCHEMA and resolve_check's cancellation; natural 1/20 are judged on the KEPT die). saveBonus/bonusSources stay as the DM-identified modifiers (bonus dice such as Bless's d4 are still rolled through roll and passed as part of saveBonus). Supplied roll: requires rollOverride { basis, reason, ruleId? } with the same validation as durationOverride (reuse the house-rule lookup); refused without it; advantage/disadvantage together with a supplied roll is refused (the supplied value is the final natural). Add optional visibility (VISIBILITY_SCHEMA, default player_visible).
2. restore_usage recharge mode: for a recharge_roll counter, omitting roll (and amount) makes the engine roll the counter's recharge die from ctx.rng and judge it against the threshold. A supplied roll requires rollOverride as above. No modifier input (the SRD prints none for recharge). Optional visibility, default dm_only. amount mode is unchanged (DM rulings and legacy/ad-hoc items; canonical items use use_item) but its description must not imply the amount is verified, and the inventory must state that it is DM-supplied.
3. Provenance: the tool result and the persisted state/event record carry roll provenance: engine-rolled (dice, kept, dropped, natural) or dm-supplied (basis, reason, ruleId). The existing window/once-per-turn refusals for recharge rolls keep working for both paths.
4. Player-visible roll ledger (orchestrator/playerVisibleRollLedger.ts) renders engine-rolled death saves (category death_save) and recharge rolls, from tool data, honoring visibility; a dm-supplied roll renders marked as DM-supplied.
5. Turn auditor policy (orchestrator/turnAuditor.ts AUDIT_POLICY): an engine roll inside record_death_save/restore_usage is executed roll evidence; a supplied roll is acceptable only with a rollOverride, and the narration must match the recorded result.
6. Tool descriptions and DM guidance: remove every instruction to roll via roll first and pass the natural (grep packages/core/src and docs for record_death_save/restore_usage guidance).
7. rules/deterministicCapabilityInventory.ts entries for both tools: operation, requiredInputs, exclusions and residualDmInterpretation state the new contract truthfully (engine-rolled by default; override recorded and unbound; amount is DM-supplied).
8. Sibling search: enumerate every tool input that accepts a die result (natural, roll, rolls, total, rolled counts) across orchestrator tool*.ts, rests, level-up, use_item, start_effect. Record each with its disposition in the completion notes; anything else that is caller-supplied and unverified is brought under the same contract here or filed as a pre-freeze bead blocking eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.22 with a stated reason.
9. Replay: engine rolls come from ctx.rng, so checkpoint/replay must reproduce them as it does for resolve_check; prove it where the existing replay tests cover tool rolls.
10. If packages/core/scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/candidateGates.ts or other generated-limit text names eshyra-o9bd.19.5.14 as undecided, update it. Do NOT edit dated candidate-record docs under docs/audits (history), freeze-manifest.json or thaw notes.

EVIDENCE: proportionate permanent tests per AGENTS.md Permanent Test Evidence: engine path (seeded natural, advantage/disadvantage kept die, nat1/nat20 with saveBonus), override path (accepted with basis; refused without; house-rule ruleId validated; advantage+supplied refused), recharge engine roll vs threshold and window refusal, ledger rendering, inventory statements.
acceptance_criteria: Both tools roll from the seeded RNG when no result is supplied, honoring DM-declared modifiers; a supplied result requires a recorded override (start_effect precedent); provenance persisted and rendered; auditor policy, guidance and capability inventory truthful; sibling search recorded; npm run verify:worktree passes; reviewed PR merged.
